clock.derivation: BYTE_NUM=1 -> HS_S2P_RATIO=1:8; configured 480 Mbit/s per lane / 8 -> 60 MHz. SDC pad period4.167ns -> approximately240MHz DDR pad -> approximately60MHz byte. The input camera clock, not I_lp_clk=100MHz, determines the byte clock.
clock.source_mclk: cnn/template/design_top_wrapper.v:483,493,517-520 ties S_24m_clk to O_cam_24m and sensor configuration; uicfgcs500_720p.v:120 selects uics500reg_720p60.
limits: No measured frequency, clock-stop duration, frame-period jitter or sensor register readback.
Sensor PLL-register-to-frequency decoding not independently proved from sensor datasheet; nominal rate is source configuration comment plus matching receiver/SDC assumptions.
SDC is a timing assumption, not board evidence.

sof.physical_generation: S_head_en=~S_hs_valid_1d & I_hs_valid; O_csi_frame_start <= S_head_en_1d && S_hs_data_1d[15:8]==8'h00. This is a short-packet event, independent of RAW pixel valid.
pipeline: uial2axis resets counters on I_data_start and reconstructs axis_tuser only at first valid pixel: vcnt=0,hcnt=0,axis_tvalid (lines53-76)
zhenghe reconstructs first-line SOF at x_cnt==rd_valid_width_d0+1,y_cnt==0 and registers output (lines134-190)
bilinear_interpolation shifts SOF and valid five registers (lines894-906)
selected awb directly assigns O_tuser=I_tuser (line370) while O_tvalid=valid_d2 from separate signal_delay path (lines184-199,229-237,356-371)
sof.valid_relationship: At zhenghe SOF comparator, rd_valid is also true under normal configured bounds; raw_matrix/bilinear delay corresponding user/valid. AWB breaks that alignment by bypassing SOF while valid/data traverse its delay circuit. Do not gate the source event with O_analysis_valid; a SOF-before-valid case is required.
sof.pulse_width: For current width1280, data_complete_delay50, known reset state and normal frame sequencing, zhenghe comparison target is nonzero (>=51); x_cnt either increments or returns to0 each clock, so the comparison is single-cycle. Subsequent 3+5 register shifts preserve width and AWB bypass adds no cycles. AWB interface itself does not shorten an arbitrary multi-cycle I_tuser. No simulator waveform or formal pulse-width proof was run.
sof.identity_boundary: AWB SOF is a pixel-pipeline reconstructed event, not the CSI packet pulse directly delayed. Source code alone does not establish one AWB SOF for every physical CSI SOF under missing/malformed pixels. To count all physical frames including skipped frames, count CSI packet SOF or first prove the mapping; expose the chosen event explicitly.
sof.latency_boundary: zhenghe SOF output -> AWB/analysis SOF has 3+5 downstream register stages, no AWB SOF delay. CSI packet -> AWB SOF and AWB SOF -> first AWB valid include counter/line/buffer behavior and have not been measured. capture_ms at AWB boundary is not a sensor exposure timestamp.
sof.template_binding: cnn/template/design_top_wrapper.v:668-671 leaves O_analysis_* unconnected. Production top user_source/hdl_source/design_top_wrapper.v:728-731 connects them to old grayscale branch; neither implements new CNN source identity binding.

font.latency_accounting: hdmi_mixer.v:76-87,142 has three register stages from I_video_vs/hs/de to outputs; source RGB read-data also has3 register assignments to output. Original CNN template has no road_box/status overlays. Production top has mixer->box->status->HDMI at lines1101-1166; box and status each add1 pixel clock, for5 timing-register stages vs3 in CNN template. Proposed standalone age adapter adds1. These are source-level relative pipeline counts, not full camera/DDR/HDMI latency measurements.
